text:
jane_cust: Hey team — starting ~last night our app started getting 400s when invoking our function handle. Example error from the API: {"error":"tool_not_found","message":"No tool matching 'pdf-extractor'"}. We didn't change the client. Using SDK v2.

alex_g: Thanks — can you paste the exact request (redact PII) and the tool name you sent?

jane_cust: Payload (redacted):
```
POST /v1/call
{
  "model": "redwood-3b",
  "tool": "pdf-extractor",
  "input": "s3://bucket/invoice.pdf"
}
```
Response: 400 + JSON above.

samir_eng: We rolled a registry canonicalization migration last night that normalizes handles (dashes -> underscores) for internal consistency. Looks like your client is still calling the old dash form. The registry backfill is rolling but not all edge caches have been updated yet.

jane_cust: We never renamed it on purpose. Weird that server would start rejecting the dash. Any quick workaround so our customers stop failing?

samir_eng: Two immediate options: 1) call the function by its UUID (stable) until alias propagation completes, or 2) temporarily map the old dash alias to the new underscore handle in the registry (we can do a hotfix). Can you try the UUID approach to confirm?

alex_g: If you can reproduce, please paste the failing request_id (from response headers) and the first-message ts so we can correlate logs.

jane_cust: Tried UUID approach and that worked. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","tool_uuid":"tool_abc123def","input":"s3://bucket/invoice.pdf"}'
```
Response: 200 + tool output.

maria_ops: Starting a forced alias-cache flush for edge nodes in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 now. I'll post when done.

samir_eng: I'll also create a short-term alias map that makes 'pdf-extractor' -> 'pdf_extractor' until clients upgrade. Longer term we'll add tolerant lookup in the SDK to try both variants. Opening an internal ticket: https://go/internal/RED-2321 (private).

alex_g: Thanks. For root cause: migration changed canonical handle format, but some edges still had cached mappings that didn't include the new alias. That produced a tool lookup mismatch.

jane_cust: Appreciate it — UUID workaround unblocks us. Please let us know when the alias is back.

maria_ops: Cache flush finished at 1915556740. Edges reported success: us-west-2 (100%), eu-west-1 (100%). :white_check_mark:

samir_eng: Deployed temporary alias map at 1915556752. Also added a short-lived metric to count 'tool_lookup_fallbacks' so we can see clients hit the old name.

alex_g: Can you confirm no billing/quotas were affected?

jane_cust: Confirmed — calls that used UUID were billed normally. No quota spikes.

samir_eng: Closing the customer-facing part of the incident. Followups: SDK tolerant-lookup RFC, and a registry sanity-check job to run after migrations. I'll post PRs.

jane_cust: Thank you all, going to prod now. :thumbsup:

maria_ops: Marking resolved for now. Will reopen if we see more hits. :eyes:
